# GOAL 
The aim of this script is arrange plots from different subset scripts aside each other to compare them across the whole cohort.

# Load libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(ggpubr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ArchR)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggbreak)
library(scales)
library(vctrs)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(ggrastr)
library(cowplot)
```

```{r}
order_matrix_mt_clone_celltype <- function(mat, 
                                           cell_ann, 
                                           first_ann # mtDNA_clone
                                           ){
  geneOrder <- sort(rowSums(mat), decreasing = TRUE, index.return = TRUE)$ix

  first_ann_freq <- enframe(first_ann,
                      name="label_cellbarcode",
                      value = "mtDNA_clone") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(mtDNA_clone) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(frequency_first=n()) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(frequency_first)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mtDNA_clone=factor(mtDNA_clone, mtDNA_clone))%>%
  pull(mtDNA_clone)

  scoreCol <- function(x) {
    score <- 0
    for (i in 1:length(x)) {
      if (x[i]) {
        score <- score + 2^(length(x) - i)
      }
    }
    return(score)
  }
  
  clone_variant_means <- list()
  for (clone in levels(first_ann)[levels(first_ann) %in% first_ann[colnames(mat)]]){
    if (!(is.null(dim(mat[,first_ann[colnames(mat)] ==clone])))){
    clone_variant_means[[clone]] <- mat[,first_ann[colnames(mat)] ==clone] %>%
      rowMeans(na.rm = TRUE)
    }    
  }
  
  clone_mean_VAFs <- clone_variant_means %>% bind_rows(.id = "clone") %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = -clone, values_to = "mean_VAF", names_to = "variant_id") %>% 
    group_by(variant_id) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(clone=as.numeric(clone)) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(clone, desc(mean_VAF)) %>%
    ungroup
  
    select_unique_mutations <- function(df) {
    selected_mutations <- character(0)  # Track already picked mutations
    
    clones <- unique(df$clone)
    result <- tibble()
    
    for (cl in clones) {
      df_clone <- df %>%
        dplyr::filter(clone == cl, !variant_id %in% selected_mutations) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(desc(mean_VAF))
      
      if (nrow(df_clone) > 0) {
        top_mut <- df_clone %>% slice_head(n = 1)
        selected_mutations <- c(selected_mutations, top_mut$variant_id)
        result <- bind_rows(result, top_mut)
      }
    }
    
    return(result)
  }  
  
  variantOrder <- clone_mean_VAFs %>% select_unique_mutations() %>% pull(variant_id) %>% append(setdiff(rownames(mat), .))
  
  scores <- apply(mat[variantOrder, , drop = FALSE], 2, scoreCol)

  barcodes_celltype_first_ann_ordered <- tibble("label_cellbarcode"=colnames(mat),
         "scores_memosort"=scores) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype=cell_ann[label_cellbarcode],
                  mtDNA_clone=first_ann[label_cellbarcode],
                  mtDNA_clone=factor(mtDNA_clone, levels=levels(first_ann_freq)),
                  celltype=factor(celltype, levels=(c("MBL_B_Cells", "CLL_B_Cells"))) )%>% 
    dplyr::group_by(mtDNA_clone) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(mtDNA_clone, celltype, desc(scores_memosort)) %>% 
    pull(label_cellbarcode)
  
      return(list(variantOrder, barcodes_celltype_first_ann_ordered))
}
```


```{r}
make_mtDNAclone_celltype_heteroplasmy_heatmap <- function(meta_data,
                                                          heteroplasmy_matrix, # variants in rownames; cell barcodes in column names
                                                         patient_name, # character string
                                                         celltype_annotation, # named vector
                                                         mtDNA_clone_annotation, # named vector
                                                         mtDNA_clone_colours # named vector
                                                         )
{
  metadata_heatmaps <- meta_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(data_type == "ATAC") %>%
    dplyr::select(patient_id, label, disease, MBL_subtype) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      MBL_CLL_subtype = if_else(is.na(MBL_subtype), "CLL", MBL_subtype),
      longitudinal = if_else(str_starts(label, "CLL"), "paired", "individual")
    )

  patient_id2plotting_id_intern <- metadata_all %>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id, plotting_id) %>%
  unique() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(plotting_id=factor(plotting_id, 
                                   levels=c(paste0("P", 1:9), "P9dup", paste0("P", 10:24)))) %>% 
  deframe()
  
  cell_matrix <- heteroplasmy_matrix  %>%
    .[rowSums(.) != 0,,drop=FALSE] %>% 
    .[, colSums(.) != 0, drop=FALSE] %>% 
    .[,colSums(is.na(.))<nrow(.),drop=FALSE]
  
  ordering <- order_matrix_mt_clone_celltype(mat = cell_matrix,
                                             cell_ann =celltype_annotation,
                                             first_ann = mtDNA_clone_annotation)
  

  cell_matrix <- -log10(cell_matrix)
  
  #reconcatenate columns and replace 0 with NA for complex heatmap
  cell_matrix <- as.matrix(cell_matrix)
  cell_matrix[cell_matrix == Inf] <- NA
  
  # order matrix in place
  cell_matrix_ordered <- cell_matrix[ordering[[1]], ordering[[2]], drop=FALSE]
  
  # prepare top celltype annotation
  celltype2colour <- c(
  "B" = "darkred",
  "CD8 T" = "azure4",
  "CD4 T" = "darkblue",
  "DC" = "darkmagenta",
  "Mono" = "tan",
  "NK" = "gold",
  "other" = "cadetblue1",
  "T" = "darkblue",
  "MBL B Cell" = "#FC8D62",
  "CLL B Cell" = "#66C2A5",
  "HC-MBL B Cell" ="#FC8D62" ,
  "LC-MBL B Cell" ="#fcbda4" ,  
  "HC_MBL_B_Cells" ="#FC8D62" ,
  "LC_MBL_B_Cells" ="#fcbda4" ,
  "MBL_B_Cells" ="#FC8D62",
  "CLL_B_Cells" ="#66C2A5")
  
  barcode2celltype <- celltype_annotation
  
  # prepare top mtDNA annotations
  mtDNAclone2colour <- mtDNA_clone_colours
  barcode2mtDNAclone <- mtDNA_clone_annotation %>% as.character() %>% setNames(names(mtDNA_clone_annotation))
  
  column_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  "mtDNA clone" = anno_simple(x= barcode2mtDNAclone[colnames(cell_matrix_ordered)], 
                        col=mtDNAclone2colour,
                        border = TRUE,
                        height = unit(0.19, "cm")),
  "Cell type" = anno_simple(x = barcode2celltype[colnames(cell_matrix_ordered)], 
                            col = celltype2colour, 
                            border = TRUE, 
                            height = unit(0.19, "cm")),
  which = "column",
  show_annotation_name = TRUE,
  show_legend = FALSE
)

  
  # Colouring
  # edit legend manually to >6 as max cut off
  col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0, 2), c("darkred", "yellow"))
  
  hm <- Heatmap(matrix = cell_matrix_ordered,
                top_annotation = column_ha,
                cluster_rows=FALSE,
                cluster_columns = FALSE ,
                col = col_fun,
                na_col = "white",
                border_gp = gpar(col = "black", lty = 1),
                raster_by_magick = TRUE,
                use_raster = TRUE,
                raster_quality = 6,
                
                #column parameters
                column_title = patient_id2plotting_id_intern[patient_name],
                column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                show_column_names = FALSE,
                
                #row parameters
                row_title = "mtDNA mutation",
                row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                show_row_names = TRUE,

                #legend parameters
                heatmap_legend_param = list(
                  title = "Heteroplasmy",
                  direction = "vertical",
                  legend_direction = "vertical",
                  at = c(2, 1, 0),
                  labels = c("≤ 1", "10", "100"),
                  title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "plain") ,
                  labels_gp = gpar(
                       fontsize = 10,
                       fontface = "plain")))
  
  # needs to be a grob for heatmap to be placable in cowplot grid
  hm_grob <- grid::grid.grabExpr(draw(hm,
     show_heatmap_legend=FALSE))
  
  return(hm_grob)
}
```

## MBL vs. CLL

### Quantification
```{r warning=FALSE}
mt_mutation_counts <- bind_rows(
  VAF_values_all_paired %>%

      dplyr::left_join(metadata_all %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, label, disease, plotting_id) %>% unique(), by = join_by(label)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(VAF != 0) %>%
      dplyr::select(plotting_id, disease, variant_id) %>%
      group_by(plotting_id, disease) %>%

    bind_rows(),
  VAF_values_all_unpaired %>%

      dplyr::filter(VAF != 0) %>%
      dplyr::select(plotting_id, disease, variant_id) %>%
      group_by(plotting_id, disease) %>%
```

### Scatterplots per patient
```{r warning=FALSE}
# Calculate Heteroplasmy mean per sample [%]
mean_heteroplasmy_variant <- VAF_values_all_paired %>%
  map(~ tidyr::unite(., "label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::filter(variant_id != "310T>C") %>%
      left_join(y = my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("MBL_B_Cells", "CLL_B_Cells")) %>%
      group_by(label, variant_id) %>%
      summarise_at(vars(VAF), list(`Heteroplasmy mean per sample` = mean)) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = `Heteroplasmy mean per sample`) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        `Heteroplasmy mean MBL` = ends_with(".1"),
        `Heteroplasmy mean CLL` = ends_with(".2")
      )
  )

# Calculate p-values between MBL and CLL Heteroplasmy
p_values_heteroplasmy_variant <- VAF_values_all_paired %>%
  imap(~ tidyr::unite(., "label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::filter(variant_id != "310T>C") %>%
      dplyr::left_join(y = my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("MBL_B_Cells", "CLL_B_Cells")) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(variant_id) %>%
      do(p_value = wilcox.test(filter(., My_annotation == "MBL_B_Cells") %>% pull(VAF),
        filter(., My_annotation == "CLL_B_Cells") %>% pull(VAF),
        paired = FALSE
      )$p.value) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        p_value = unlist(p_value),
        patient_id = .y
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate("p_adjust" = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH", n = length(.$p_value)))
  )

statistics_heteroplasmy_variant <- mean_heteroplasmy_variant %>%
  map2(p_values_heteroplasmy_variant, ~ left_join(.x, .y, by = join_by(variant_id)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      significance = p_adjust <= 0.05 & p_value <= 0.05,
      variant_label = case_when(significance == "TRUE" ~ variant_id, .default = NA)
    ))
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=9, warning=FALSE}
scatterplot_heteroplasmy_variants <- statistics_heteroplasmy_variant[names(statistics_heteroplasmy_variant)!="CLL6"] %>% 
  imap(~ arrange(.x, significance) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(aes(
      x = `Heteroplasmy mean CLL`,
      y = `Heteroplasmy mean MBL`,
      colour = `significance`,
      label = variant_label
    )) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_abline(colour = "lightgrey", intercept = 0, linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_function(fun = function(x) 1.5 * x, colour = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_function(fun = function(x) x / 1.5, colour = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_text(size = 2, nudge_y = .1, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_colour_manual(name = "Significant", values = c("FALSE" = "lightgrey", "TRUE" = "darkred")) +
    scale_y_log10(limits = c(0.00001, 1.3), labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x))) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(0.00001, 1.3), labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x))) +
    labs(title = .y) +
    theme_pub() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = NULL,
      panel.grid.minor = NULL
    )
)

ggarrange(plotlist = scatterplot_heteroplasmy_variants, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
```

#### Percentage stable/instable mutations and median across patients
```{r}
statistics_heteroplasmy_variant[names(statistics_heteroplasmy_variant)!="CLL6"] %>%
  imap(~ mutate(.x,
      `Change CLL/MBL` = (`Heteroplasmy mean CLL` / `Heteroplasmy mean MBL`),
      `threshold_1_5_fc` = `Change CLL/MBL` >= 1.5 & significance == TRUE | `Change CLL/MBL` <= 1 / 1.5 & significance == TRUE,
      `Stability` = if_else(threshold_1_5_fc == TRUE, "Instable", "Stable")
    )
  ) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = paste0("CLL", 1:10)),
    Stability = factor(Stability, levels = c("Stable", "Instable"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(patient_id, Stability) %>%
  dplyr::summarise("mutation_counts" = n()) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Stability, values_from = mutation_counts) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Instable = if_else(is.na(Instable), 0, Instable)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Total = sum(Stable, Instable),
    "Stable_perc" = Stable / Total * 100,
    "Instable_perc" = Instable / Total * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Total_sum=sum(Total),
    Total_median=median(Total),
    Total_mean=mean(Total),
    Total_min=min(Total),
    Total_max=max(Total),
    Total_instable=sum(Instable),
    Total_instable_perc=sum(Instable)/Total_sum,
    median_stable = median(Stable),
    median_perc_stable = median(Stable_perc),
    mean_stable=mean(Stable),
    mean_perc_stable=mean(Stable_perc, na.rm=TRUE),
    median_instable = median(Instable),
    median_perc_instable = median(Instable_perc),
    mean_instable = mean(Instable),
    mean_perc_instable = mean(Instable_perc, na.rm=TRUE)
  ) 
```

```{r}
  imap(~ mutate(.x,
      `Change CLL/MBL` = (`Heteroplasmy mean CLL` / `Heteroplasmy mean MBL`),
      `threshold_1_5_fc` = `Change CLL/MBL` >= 1.5 & significance == TRUE | `Change CLL/MBL` <= 1 / 1.5 & significance == TRUE,
      `Stability` = if_else(threshold_1_5_fc == TRUE, "Instable", "Stable")
    )
  ) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = paste0("CLL", 1:10)),
    Stability = factor(Stability, levels = c("Stable", "Instable"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(patient_id, Stability) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(patient_id == "CLL3" & variant_id == "11711G>A"|
                patient_id == "MBL15" & variant_id == "13886T>C"|
                patient_id == "CLL1" & variant_id == "2857T>C"|
                patient_id == "CLL7" & variant_id == "11435G>A"|
                patient_id == "CLL8" & variant_id == "16519T>C")) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise("mutation_counts" = n()) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Stability, values_from = mutation_counts) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Instable = if_else(is.na(Instable), 0, Instable)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Total = sum(Stable, Instable),
    "Stable_perc" = Stable / Total * 100,
    "Instable_perc" = Instable / Total * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Total_sum=sum(Total),
    Total_median=median(Total),
    Total_mean=mean(Total),
    Total_min=min(Total),
    Total_max=max(Total),
    Total_instable=sum(Instable),
    Total_instable_perc=sum(Instable)/Total_sum,
    median_stable = median(Stable),
    median_perc_stable = median(Stable_perc),
    mean_stable=mean(Stable),
    mean_perc_stable=mean(Stable_perc, na.rm=TRUE),
    median_instable = median(Instable),
    median_perc_instable = median(Instable_perc),
    mean_instable = mean(Instable),
    mean_perc_instable = mean(Instable_perc, na.rm=TRUE)
  ) 
```

## Healthy B cells vs. malignant 
### Progressive MBL
```{r warning=FALSE}
# Calculate Heteroplasmy mean per sample [%] for MBL and CLL cells
mean_heteroplasmy_HC_MBL_CLL <- c(VAF_values_all_paired, VAF_values_all_unpaired["MBL4"]) %>% 
  map(~ tidyr::unite(., "label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(variant_id != "310T>C") %>%
    left_join(y = my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("MBL_B_Cells", "CLL_B_Cells")) %>%
    group_by(label, variant_id, My_annotation) %>%
    dplyr::summarise_at(vars(VAF), list(`Heteroplasmy mean per sample` = mean)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-label) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = My_annotation, values_from = `Heteroplasmy mean per sample`) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      `Heteroplasmy mean MBL cells` = starts_with("MBL"),
      `Heteroplasmy mean CLL cells` = starts_with("CLL")
    )
)

# Calculate mean heteroplasmy for B cells in ALL disease states
mean_heteroplasmy_B <- c(VAF_values_all_paired, VAF_values_all_unpaired["MBL4"])  %>% 
  imap(~ tidyr::unite(.x, "label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(variant_id != "310T>C") %>%
    left_join(y = my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("B")) %>%
    group_by(variant_id, My_annotation) %>%
    dplyr::summarise_at(vars(VAF), list(`Heteroplasmy mean per sample` = mean)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = My_annotation, values_from = `Heteroplasmy mean per sample`) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      `Heteroplasmy mean B cells` = ends_with("B")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(patient_id = .y)
)

# Calculate p-values between B and MBL and CLL Heteroplasmy
p_values_heteroplasmy_B_HC_MBL <- VAF_values_all_paired %>%
  imap(
    ~ dplyr::filter(.x, variant_id != "310T>C") %>%
      tidyr::unite("label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
      left_join(y = my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("B", "MBL_B_Cells")) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(variant_id) %>%
      do(p_value = wilcox.test(filter(., My_annotation == "B") %>% pull(VAF),
        filter(., My_annotation == "MBL_B_Cells") %>% pull(VAF),
        paired = FALSE
      )$p.value) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        p_value = unlist(p_value),
        patient_id = .y
      ) %>%
      mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH", n = length(.$p_value)))
  )

p_values_heteroplasmy_B_CLL <- c(VAF_values_all_paired, VAF_values_all_unpaired["MBL4"])  %>%
  imap(
    ~ dplyr::filter(.x, variant_id != "310T>C") %>%
      tidyr::unite("label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
      left_join(y = my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("B", "CLL_B_Cells")) %>%
      group_by(variant_id) %>%
      do(p_value = wilcox.test(filter(., My_annotation == "B") %>% pull(VAF),
        filter(., My_annotation == "CLL_B_Cells") %>% pull(VAF),
        paired = FALSE
      )$p.value) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        p_value = unlist(p_value),
        patient_id = .y
      ) %>%
      mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH", n = length(.$p_value)))
  )

# Combine statistic results with mean heteroplasmy per celltype
statistics_heteroplasmy_B_paired_HC_MBL <- mean_heteroplasmy_HC_MBL_CLL %>%
  map2(
    mean_heteroplasmy_B,
    ~ left_join(.x, .y, by = join_by(variant_id))
  ) %>%
  map2(
    p_values_heteroplasmy_B_CLL,
    ~ dplyr::left_join(.x, .y, by = join_by(variant_id, patient_id)) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        p_value_B_vs_CLL = p_value,
        p_adjust_B_vs_CLL = p_adjust
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        significance_B_vs_CLL = p_adjust_B_vs_CLL <= 0.05 & p_value_B_vs_CLL <= 0.05,
        variant_label_B_vs_CLL = case_when(significance_B_vs_CLL == "TRUE" ~ variant_id, .default = NA)
      )
  )

statistics_heteroplasmy_B_paired_HC_MBL[names(statistics_heteroplasmy_B_paired_HC_MBL) != "MBL4"]  <- statistics_heteroplasmy_B_paired_HC_MBL[names(statistics_heteroplasmy_B_paired_HC_MBL) != "MBL4"] %>% 
  map2(
    p_values_heteroplasmy_B_HC_MBL,
    ~ dplyr::left_join(.x, .y, by = join_by(variant_id, patient_id)) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        p_value_B_vs_MBL = p_value,
        p_adjust_B_vs_HC_MBL = p_adjust
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        significance_B_vs_HC_MBL = p_adjust_B_vs_HC_MBL <= 0.05 & p_value_B_vs_MBL <= 0.05,
        variant_label_B_vs_MBL = case_when(significance_B_vs_HC_MBL == "TRUE" ~ variant_id, .default = NA)
      )
  )
```

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
                `Heteroplasmy mean B cells percent`=if_else(`Heteroplasmy mean B cells`==0.000000e+00,
                                                      minimum_VAF_unpaired_HC_MBL * 10^-1, 
                                                      `Heteroplasmy mean B cells percent`),
                `Heteroplasmy mean MBL cells percent`=`Heteroplasmy mean MBL cells`*100,
                `Heteroplasmy mean MBL cells percent`=if_else(`Heteroplasmy mean MBL cells`== 0.000000e+00, 
                                                        minimum_VAF_unpaired_HC_MBL * 10^-1, 
                                                        `Heteroplasmy mean MBL cells percent`),
                variant_label = if_else(!is.na(variant_patient_id), 
                                        paste0(plotting_id, " ", variant_id),
                                        variant_patient_id)) %>%
  arrange(threshold_1_5_FC) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(
    x = `Heteroplasmy mean B cells percent`,
    y = `Heteroplasmy mean MBL cells percent`,
    colour = threshold_1_5_FC, 
    label=variant_label
  )) +
  geom_abline(colour = "lightgrey", intercept = 0, linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_function(fun = function(x) 1.5 * x, colour = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_function(fun = function(x) x / 1.5, colour = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text_repel(nudge_x = -0.8, nudge_y = 0, colour="black", max.overlaps = Inf)+
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Stability", 
                      values = c("TRUE"="#956A77", "FALSE"="lightgrey"), 
                      labels=c("TRUE"="Instable", "FALSE"="Stable")) +
  scale_x_log10(name="Mean heteroplasmy B [%]", 
                limits = c(0.001, 100), 
                labels = scales::label_comma(), 
                oob=scales::squish_infinite, 
                expand=expansion(mult = c(0.07, 0.05))) +
  scale_y_log10(name="Mean heteroplasmy non-progressive MBL [%]",
                limits = c(0.001, 100), 
                labels = scales::label_comma(), 
                oob=scales::squish_infinite, 
                expand=expansion(mult = c(0.07, 0.05))) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.8, 0.6),
        legend.direction = "vertical",
    panel.grid.major = NULL,
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

### CLL
```{r warning=FALSE}
# Calculate Heteroplasmy mean per sample [%]
mean_heteroplasmy_unpaired_CLL <- VAF_values_all_unpaired["MBL4"] %>% 
  imap(~ tidyr::unite(., "label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
    left_join(y = my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("CLL_B_Cells")) %>%
    group_by(variant_id, My_annotation) %>%
    summarise_at(vars(VAF), list(`Heteroplasmy mean per sample` = mean)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = My_annotation, values_from = `Heteroplasmy mean per sample`) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      `Heteroplasmy mean MBL cells` = starts_with("MBL")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(patient_id = .y) %>%
    relocate(patient_id, .before = variant_id)
)

mean_heteroplasmy_B_unpaired_HC_MBL <- VAF_values_all_unpaired[c(paste0("MBL", c(1:2, 6:9)))] %>% 
  imap( ~ tidyr::unite(., "label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
    left_join(y = my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("B")) %>%
    group_by(variant_id, My_annotation) %>%
    summarise_at(vars(VAF), list(`Heteroplasmy mean per sample` = mean)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = My_annotation, values_from = `Heteroplasmy mean per sample`) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      `Heteroplasmy mean B cells` = starts_with("B")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(patient_id = .y)
)

# Calculate p-values between B and MBL Heteroplasmy
p_values_heteroplasmy_B_unpaired_HC_MBL <- VAF_values_all_unpaired[c(paste0("MBL", c(1:2, 6:9)))] %>%
  imap(~ dplyr::filter(.x, variant_id != "310T>C") %>%
      tidyr::unite("label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
      left_join(y = my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("B", "MBL_B_Cells", "CLL_B_Cells")) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(variant_id) %>%
      do(p_value = wilcox.test(filter(., My_annotation == "B") %>% pull(VAF),
        filter(., My_annotation %in% c("MBL_B_Cells", "CLL_B_Cells")) %>% pull(VAF),
        paired = FALSE
      )$p.value) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        p_value = unlist(p_value),
        patient_id = .y
      ) %>%
      mutate(p_adjust_B_vs_HC_MBL = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH", n = length(.$p_value)))
  )

# Combine statistic results with mean heteroplasmy per celltype
statistics_heteroplasmy_B_unpaired_HC_MBL <- mean_heteroplasmy_unpaired_HC_MBL %>%
  map2(
    mean_heteroplasmy_B_unpaired_HC_MBL,
    ~ left_join(.x, .y, by = join_by(patient_id, variant_id))
  ) %>%
  map2(
    p_values_heteroplasmy_B_unpaired_HC_MBL,
    ~ dplyr::left_join(.x, .y, by = join_by(patient_id, variant_id)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        significance_B_vs_HC_MBL = p_adjust_B_vs_HC_MBL <= 0.05 & p_value <= 0.05,
        variant_label_B_vs_MBL = case_when(significance_B_vs_HC_MBL == "TRUE" ~ variant_id, .default = NA)
      )
  )
```

### HC-MBL
```{r warning=FALSE}
# Calculate Heteroplasmy mean per sample [%] for MBL B and other immune cells
mean_heteroplasmy_HC_MBL_other <- c(VAF_values_all_paired, VAF_values_all_unpaired) %>% 
  .[names(.) %in% paste0("MBL", c(1:3, 5:9))] %>% 
  map(~ tidyr::unite(., "label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(variant_id != "310T>C") %>%
    left_join(y = my_annotation_df,by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(My_annotation=if_else(!My_annotation %in% c("MBL_B_Cells", "B"), "Other immune cells", My_annotation)) %>% 
    group_by(label, variant_id, My_annotation) %>%
    dplyr::summarise_at(vars(VAF), list(`Heteroplasmy mean per sample` = mean)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-label) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = My_annotation, values_from = `Heteroplasmy mean per sample`) %>%
    dplyr::rename(`Heteroplasmy mean other immune cells` = starts_with("Other"),
      `Heteroplasmy mean MBL cells` = starts_with("MBL"),
      `Heteroplasmy mean B cells` = starts_with("B")))

# Calculate p-values between MBL B and Other immune cell Heteroplasmy
p_values_heteroplasmy_B_HC_MBL_other <- c(VAF_values_all_paired, VAF_values_all_unpaired) %>% 
  .[names(.) %in% paste0("MBL", c(1:3, 5:9))] %>%  
  imap(
    ~ dplyr::filter(.x, variant_id != "310T>C") %>%
      tidyr::unite("label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
      left_join(y = my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(My_annotation=if_else(!My_annotation %in% c("MBL_B_Cells", "B"), "Other immune cells", My_annotation)) %>% 
      dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("B", "Other immune cells")) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(variant_id) %>%
      do(p_value = wilcox.test(filter(., My_annotation == "B") %>% pull(VAF),
        filter(., My_annotation == "Other immune cells") %>% pull(VAF),
        paired = FALSE
      )$p.value) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        p_value = unlist(p_value),
        patient_id = .y
      ) %>%
      mutate(p_adjust_B_vs_HC_others = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH", n = length(.$p_value)))
  )

# Combine statistic results with mean heteroplasmy 
statistics_heteroplasmy_B_HC_MBL_other <- mean_heteroplasmy_HC_MBL_other %>%
  map2(
    p_values_heteroplasmy_B_HC_MBL_other,
    ~ dplyr::left_join(.x, .y, by = join_by(variant_id)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        significance_B_vs_HC_others = p_adjust_B_vs_HC_others <= 0.05 & p_value <= 0.05,
        variant_label = case_when(significance_B_vs_HC_others == "TRUE" ~ variant_id, .default = NA)
      )
  )
```

#  All significant heteroplasmy changes B vs LC/HC/CLL 
## Heatmaps across all significant comparisons with B cells
```{r order_matrix}
order_matrix <- function(mat, cell_ann, enrichment_ann) {
  geneOrder <- sort(rowSums(mat), decreasing = TRUE, index.return = TRUE)$ix

  scoreCol <- function(x) {
    score <- 0
    for (i in 1:length(x)) {
      if (x[i]) {
        score <- score + 2^(length(x) - i)
      }
    }
    return(score)
  }

  if (nrow(mat) == 1) {
  scores <- as.numeric(as.logical(mat[1, ]))
  } else {
  scores <- apply(mat[geneOrder, , drop = FALSE], 2, scoreCol)
  }
  
  # scores <- apply(mat[geneOrder, , drop = FALSE], 2, scoreCol)
  sampleOrder <- sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE, index.return = TRUE)$ix

  geneSort <- sort(rownames(mat))
  
  enrich_levels <- c("B", "LC_MBL", "HC_MBL","CLL", "not significant")
  
  enrichment_annotation <- enrichment_ann %>% 
    factor(., levels=enrich_levels)
  
  geneSortEnrich <- sort(enrichment_annotation) %>% names() %>% unique()

  barcode2celltype <- tibble::deframe(cell_ann)
  
  barcodes_celltype_ann_ordered <- tibble(
    "label_cellbarcode_M" = colnames(mat),
    "scores_memosort" = scores) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype=barcode2celltype[label_cellbarcode_M]) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("B", "LC_MBL", "HC_MBL", "CLL"))) 
    
  set.seed(123)
  barcodes_celltype_ann_ordered <- barcodes_celltype_ann_ordered[sample(nrow(barcodes_celltype_ann_ordered), replace = FALSE), ] %>% 
    group_by(celltype) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(celltype) %>%
    pull(label_cellbarcode_M)

  return(list(geneSortEnrich, barcodes_celltype_ann_ordered))
}
```

```{r make_signif_variant_heteroplasmy_heatmap}
make_signif_variant_heteroplasmy_heatmap <- function(meta_data,
                                                     changes_oi,
                                                     heteroplasmy_lst_df_long, #lst; long format
                                                     selected_mutations,
                                                     patient_name, # character string
                                                     enrichment_annotation,
                                                     enrichment_colours) 
{
  metadata_heatmaps <- meta_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(data_type == "ATAC") %>%
    dplyr::select(patient_id, label, disease, MBL_subtype) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      MBL_CLL_subtype = if_else(is.na(MBL_subtype), "CLL", MBL_subtype),
      longitudinal = if_else(str_starts(label, "CLL"), "paired", "individual")
    )

  patient_id2plotting_id_intern <- metadata_all %>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id, plotting_id) %>%
  unique() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(plotting_id=factor(plotting_id, 
                                   levels=c(paste0("P", 1:9), "P9dup", paste0("P", 10:24)))) %>% 
  deframe()
  
  # we are only interested in B-like cells as too little immune cells
  filtered_VAF_values <- heteroplasmy_lst_df_long %>%
    tidyr::unite( col = label_cellbarcode, label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::select(patient_id, variant_id, label, label_cellbarcode, VAF) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(My_annotation)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(metadata_heatmaps, by = join_by(patient_id, label)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("B", "MBL_B_Cells", "CLL_B_Cells")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        My_heatmap_annotation = case_when(My_annotation == "MBL_B_Cells" & MBL_CLL_subtype == "LC" ~ "LC_MBL",
          My_annotation == "MBL_B_Cells" & MBL_CLL_subtype == "HC" ~ "HC_MBL",
          My_annotation == "CLL_B_Cells" & MBL_CLL_subtype == "CLL" ~ "CLL",
          .default = My_annotation
        ),
        My_heatmap_annotation = factor(My_heatmap_annotation, levels = c("B", "LC_MBL", "HC_MBL", "CLL"))
      )

  celltypes <- changes_oi %>%
    dplyr::pull(comparison) %>%
    str_split(pattern = "_vs_") %>%
    unlist() %>%
    unique()

  barcode2celltype <- filtered_VAF_values %>%
    dplyr::filter(My_heatmap_annotation %in% celltypes) %>%
    dplyr::select(label_cellbarcode, My_heatmap_annotation) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(My_heatmap_annotation=as.character(My_heatmap_annotation)) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(My_heatmap_annotation) %>%
    deframe()
  
  celltype2colour <- c("LC_MBL"="#FCBDA4","HC_MBL"="#FC8D62", "CLL" ="#66C2A5","B"="darkred")

  variant2comparison <- changes_oi %>%
    dplyr::select(variant_id, comparison) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(comparison) %>%
    deframe()

  cell_matrix <- filtered_VAF_values %>%
    dplyr::filter(My_heatmap_annotation %in% celltypes) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(My_heatmap_annotation) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = "variant_id", names_from = "label_cellbarcode", values_from = "VAF") %>%
    dplyr::filter(variant_id %in% 
                    changes_oi$variant_id & variant_id %in% 
                    selected_mutations) %>%
    column_to_rownames("variant_id") %>%
    as.matrix() 

  ordering <- order_matrix(mat = cell_matrix,
                           cell_ann = barcode2celltype,
                           enrichment_ann = enrichment_annotation)

  cell_matrix <- -log10(cell_matrix)

  # reconcatenate columns and replace 0 with NA for complex heatmap
  cell_matrix <- as.matrix(cell_matrix)
  cell_matrix[cell_matrix == Inf] <- NA

  # order matrix in place
  cell_matrix_ordered <- cell_matrix[ordering[[1]][ordering[[1]] %in% rownames(cell_matrix)], ordering[[2]], drop=FALSE]

  # prepare top celltype annotation
  colours <- list(
    "Cell type" = celltype2colour
  )
  
  anno_df <- tibble(
    "Cell type" = barcode2celltype[colnames(cell_matrix_ordered)],
  )
  
  # column_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  #     df = anno_df,
  #     col = colours, # is list of named vectors
  #     show_legend = FALSE,
  #     border = TRUE,
  #     height = unit(0.1, "cm")
  #   )
  
  column_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
      "Cell type" = anno_simple(x = barcode2celltype[colnames(cell_matrix_ordered)], 
                            col = celltype2colour, 
                            border = TRUE, 
                            height = unit(0.19, "cm")),
  which = "column",
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  show_legend = FALSE)
  
  # prepare row annotation
  enrichment2colour <- enrichment_colours
  variant2enrichment <- enrichment_annotation
  
  
  subset_unique_names <- function(x) {
  name_counts <- table(names(x))
  if (all(name_counts == 1)) {
    return(x)
  } else {
    return(x[duplicated(names(x)) & !duplicated(names(x), fromLast = TRUE)])
  }
  }
  
  variant2enrichment <- subset_unique_names(enrichment_annotation)


  row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
    "Enrichment" =anno_simple(
    x=variant2enrichment[rownames(cell_matrix_ordered)],
    col = enrichment2colour, # is list of named vector
    border = TRUE,
    width = unit(0.19, "cm")
    ),
    show_legend = FALSE,
    show_annotation_name =FALSE)
  
  # Colouring
  # edit legend manually to >2 as max cut off
  col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0, 2), c("darkred", "yellow"))

  hm <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    matrix = cell_matrix_ordered,
    top_annotation = column_ha,
    right_annotation = row_ha,
    col = col_fun,
    name = "Heteroplasmy",
    na_col = "white",
    
    border = TRUE,
    border_gp = gpar(col = "black", lty = 1),
    
    raster_by_magick = TRUE,
    use_raster = TRUE,
    raster_quality = 6,
    
    row_title = "mtDNA mutations",
    row_title_side = "left",
    row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    
    column_title = patient_id2plotting_id_intern[patient_name],
    column_title_side = "top",
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    column_split = barcode2celltype[colnames(cell_matrix_ordered)],
    
    # legend parameters
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "Heteroplasmy [%]",
      direction = "vertical",
      legend_direction = "vertical",
      at = c(2, 1, 0),
      labels = c("\u2264 1", "10", "100"),
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "plain"),
      labels_gp = gpar(
        fontsize = 10,
        fontface = "plain"
      )
    )
  )
  
  hm_grob <- grid::grid.grabExpr(draw(hm,
    show_heatmap_legend=FALSE))

  return(hm_grob)
}
```

## Heatmaps of CNV LC-MBLs
```{r order_matrix}
order_matrix_CNV <- function(mat, cell_ann, enrichment_ann, second_ann) {
  geneOrder <- sort(rowSums(mat), decreasing = TRUE, index.return = TRUE)$ix

  scoreCol <- function(x) {
    score <- 0
    for (i in 1:length(x)) {
      if (x[i]) {
        score <- score + 2^(length(x) - i)
      }
    }
    return(score)
  }

  if (nrow(mat) == 1) {
  scores <- as.numeric(as.logical(mat[1, ]))
  } else {
  scores <- apply(mat[geneOrder, , drop = FALSE], 2, scoreCol)
  }
  
  # scores <- apply(mat[geneOrder, , drop = FALSE], 2, scoreCol)
  sampleOrder <- sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE, index.return = TRUE)$ix

  geneSort <- sort(rownames(mat))
  
  enrich_levels <- c("B", "LC_MBL", "HC_MBL","CLL", "not significant")
  
  enrichment_annotation <- enrichment_ann %>% 
    factor(., levels=enrich_levels)
  
  geneSortEnrich <- sort(enrichment_annotation) %>% names() %>% unique()

  barcode2celltype <- tibble::deframe(cell_ann)
  
  barcodes_celltype_ann_ordered <- tibble(
    "label_cellbarcode_M" = colnames(mat),
    "scores_memosort" = scores) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype=barcode2celltype[label_cellbarcode_M]) %>%
    left_join(enframe(second_ann, 
                      name="label_cellbarcode", 
                      value = "CNV"), 
              by = join_by("label_cellbarcode_M" == "label_cellbarcode")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("B", "LC_MBL", "HC_MBL", "CLL"))) 
    
  set.seed(123)
  barcodes_celltype_ann_ordered <- barcodes_celltype_ann_ordered[sample(nrow(barcodes_celltype_ann_ordered), replace = FALSE), ] %>% 
    group_by(celltype) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(celltype, desc(CNV)) %>%
    pull(label_cellbarcode_M)

  return(list(geneSortEnrich, barcodes_celltype_ann_ordered))
}
```

```{r}
make_CNV_matching_signif_variant_heteroplasmy_heatmap <- function(meta_data,
                                                     changes_oi,
                                                     heteroplasmy_lst_df_long, #lst; long format
                                                     selected_mutations,
                                                     patient_name, # character string
                                                     CNV_annotation,# named vector
                                                     CNV_colours, # named vector                     
                                                     enrichment_annotation,
                                                     enrichment_colours) 
{
  metadata_heatmaps <- meta_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(data_type == "ATAC") %>%
    dplyr::select(patient_id, label, disease, MBL_subtype) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      MBL_CLL_subtype = if_else(is.na(MBL_subtype), "CLL", MBL_subtype),
      longitudinal = if_else(str_starts(label, "CLL"), "paired", "individual")
    )

  patient_id2plotting_id_intern <- metadata_all %>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id, plotting_id) %>%
  unique() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(plotting_id=factor(plotting_id, 
                                   levels=c(paste0("P", 1:9), "P9dup", paste0("P", 10:24)))) %>% 
  deframe()
  
  # we are only interested in B-like cells as too little immune cells
  filtered_VAF_values <- heteroplasmy_lst_df_long %>%
    tidyr::unite( col = label_cellbarcode, label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::select(patient_id, variant_id, label, label_cellbarcode, VAF) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(My_annotation)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(metadata_heatmaps, by = join_by(patient_id, label)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("B", "MBL_B_Cells", "CLL_B_Cells")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(CNV=CNV_annotation[label_cellbarcode],
        My_heatmap_annotation = case_when(My_annotation == "MBL_B_Cells" & MBL_CLL_subtype == "LC" ~ "LC_MBL",
          My_annotation == "MBL_B_Cells" & MBL_CLL_subtype == "HC" ~ "HC_MBL",
          My_annotation == "CLL_B_Cells" & MBL_CLL_subtype == "CLL" ~ "CLL",
          .default = My_annotation
        ),
        My_heatmap_annotation = factor(My_heatmap_annotation, levels = c("B", "LC_MBL", "HC_MBL", "CLL"))
      ) %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(CNV))

  celltypes <- changes_oi %>%
    dplyr::pull(comparison) %>%
    str_split(pattern = "_vs_") %>%
    unlist() %>%
    unique()

  barcode2celltype <- filtered_VAF_values %>%
    dplyr::filter(My_heatmap_annotation %in% celltypes) %>%
    dplyr::select(label_cellbarcode, My_heatmap_annotation) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(My_heatmap_annotation=as.character(My_heatmap_annotation)) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(My_heatmap_annotation) %>%
    deframe()
  
  celltype2colour <- c("LC_MBL"="#FCBDA4","HC_MBL"="#FC8D62", "CLL" ="#66C2A5","B"="darkred")

  variant2comparison <- changes_oi %>%
    dplyr::select(variant_id, comparison) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(comparison) %>%
    deframe()

  cell_matrix <- filtered_VAF_values %>%
    dplyr::filter(My_heatmap_annotation %in% celltypes) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(My_heatmap_annotation) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = "variant_id", names_from = "label_cellbarcode", values_from = "VAF") %>%
    dplyr::filter(variant_id %in% changes_oi$variant_id & variant_id %in% selected_mutations) %>%
    column_to_rownames("variant_id") %>%
    as.matrix() 

  ordering <- order_matrix_CNV(mat = cell_matrix,
                           cell_ann = barcode2celltype,
                           enrichment_ann = enrichment_annotation,
                           second_ann=CNV_annotation)

  cell_matrix <- -log10(cell_matrix)

  # reconcatenate columns and replace 0 with NA for complex heatmap
  cell_matrix <- as.matrix(cell_matrix)
  cell_matrix[cell_matrix == Inf] <- NA

  # order matrix in place
  cell_matrix_ordered <- cell_matrix[ordering[[1]][ordering[[1]] %in% rownames(cell_matrix)], ordering[[2]], drop=FALSE]
  
  # prepare top CNV annotation
  CNV2colour <- CNV_colours
  barcode2CNV <- CNV_annotation  
  
  column_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
      "Cell type" = anno_simple(x = barcode2celltype[colnames(cell_matrix_ordered)], 
                            col = celltype2colour, 
                            border = TRUE, 
                            height = unit(0.19, "cm")),
      "CNV" = anno_simple(x= barcode2CNV[colnames(cell_matrix_ordered)], 
                        col=CNV2colour,
                        border = TRUE,
                        height = unit(0.19, "cm")),
  which = "column",
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  show_legend = FALSE)
  
  # prepare row annotation
  enrichment2colour <- enrichment_colours
  variant2enrichment <- enrichment_annotation
  
  subset_unique_names <- function(x) {
  name_counts <- table(names(x))
  if (all(name_counts == 1)) {
    return(x)
  } else {
    return(x[duplicated(names(x)) & !duplicated(names(x), fromLast = TRUE)])
  }
  }
  
  variant2enrichment <- subset_unique_names(enrichment_annotation)

  row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
    "Enrichment" =anno_simple(
    x=variant2enrichment[rownames(cell_matrix_ordered)],
    col = enrichment2colour, # is list of named vector
    border = TRUE,
    width = unit(0.19, "cm")
    ),
    show_legend = FALSE,
    show_annotation_name =FALSE)
  
  # Colouring
  # edit legend manually to >2 as max cut off
  col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0, 2), c("darkred", "yellow"))

  hm <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    matrix = cell_matrix_ordered,
    top_annotation = column_ha,
    right_annotation = row_ha,
    col = col_fun,
    name = "Heteroplasmy",
    na_col = "white",
    
    border = TRUE,
    border_gp = gpar(col = "black", lty = 1),
    
    raster_by_magick = TRUE,
    use_raster = TRUE,
    raster_quality = 6,
    
    row_title = "mtDNA mutations",
    row_title_side = "left",
    row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    
    column_title = patient_id2plotting_id_intern[patient_name],
    column_title_side = "top",
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    column_split = barcode2celltype[colnames(cell_matrix_ordered)],
    
    # legend parameters
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "Heteroplasmy [%]",
      direction = "vertical",
      legend_direction = "vertical",
      at = c(2, 1, 0),
      labels = c("\u2264 1", "10", "100"),
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "plain"),
      labels_gp = gpar(
        fontsize = 10,
        fontface = "plain"
      )
    )
  )
  
  hm_grob <- grid::grid.grabExpr(draw(hm,
    show_heatmap_legend=FALSE))

  return(hm_grob)
}
```

# Heatmaps of GoTChA HC-MBLs
```{r}
order_matrix_SNVs <- function(mat, cell_ann, ann, enrichment_ann){
  geneOrder <- sort(rowSums(mat), decreasing = TRUE, index.return = TRUE)$ix
  
  scoreCol <- function(x) {
    score <- 0
    for (i in 1:length(x)) {
      if (x[i]) {
        score <- score + 2^(length(x) - i)
      }
    }
    return(score)
  }
  
  geneSort <- sort(rownames(mat))
  
  enrich_levels <- c("B", "LC_MBL", "HC_MBL","CLL", "not significant")
  
  enrichment_annotation <- enrichment_ann %>% 
    factor(., levels=enrich_levels)
  
  geneSortEnrich <- sort(enrichment_annotation) %>% names() %>% unique()
  
  scores <- apply(mat[geneOrder, , drop = FALSE], 2, scoreCol)
  sampleOrder <- sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE, index.return = TRUE)$ix

  ann_freq <- enframe(ann,
                      name="label_cellbarcode",
                      value = "SNV") %>%
  group_by(SNV) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(freq_second=n()) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(freq_second)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SNV=factor(SNV),
                SNV=fct_reorder(SNV, freq_second, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(SNV)
  
  barcodes_celltype_ann_ordered <- tibble("label_cellbarcode_M"=colnames(mat),
         "scores_memosort"=scores) %>%
    left_join(enframe(cell_ann, 
                      name="label_cellbarcode", 
                      value = "celltype"), 
              by = join_by("label_cellbarcode_M" == "label_cellbarcode")) %>% 
    left_join(enframe(ann, 
                      name="label_cellbarcode", 
                      value = "SNV"), 
              by = join_by("label_cellbarcode_M" == "label_cellbarcode")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(SNV=factor(SNV, levels=levels(ann_freq))) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(celltype, desc(SNV)) %>% 
    pull(label_cellbarcode_M)
 
    return(list(geneSortEnrich, barcodes_celltype_ann_ordered))
}
```

```{r}
make_SNV_matching_heteroplasmy_heatmap <- function(meta_data,

                       fontface = "plain")))
  
  # needs to be a grob for heatmap to be placable in cowplot grid
    hm_grob <- grid::grid.grabExpr(draw(hm,
     heatmap_legend_side = "right"))
  
  return(hm_grob)
  }
}
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=3}
SNV_heatmap_data <- VAF_values_all %>% 
  map(~tidyr::unite(., col = label_cellbarcode, label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::select(patient_id, variant_id, label, label_cellbarcode, VAF) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
      left_join(metadata_all %>% dplyr::filter(data_type=="ATAC") %>% dplyr::select(label, MBL_CLL_subtype), by = join_by(label)) %>% 
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(My_annotation)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("B", "MBL_B_Cells", "CLL_B_Cells")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        My_heatmap_annotation = case_when(My_annotation == "MBL_B_Cells" & MBL_CLL_subtype == "LC" ~ "LC_MBL",
          My_annotation == "MBL_B_Cells" & MBL_CLL_subtype == "HC" ~ "HC_MBL",
          My_annotation == "CLL_B_Cells" & MBL_CLL_subtype == "CLL" ~ "CLL",
          .default = My_annotation
        ),
        My_heatmap_annotation = factor(My_heatmap_annotation, levels = c("B", "LC_MBL", "HC_MBL", "CLL"))
      ))
heteroplasmy.cln.variants <- SNV_heatmap_data %>% 
  map(~tidyr::pivot_wider(., id_cols = c(variant_id), names_from = label_cellbarcode, values_from = VAF) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("variant_id"))

SNVs <- gotcha_data %>% 
  map(~dplyr::select(., label_cellbarcode, mut_status_ts10) %>% 
        dplyr::mutate(mut_status_ts10=if_else(mut_status_ts10 =="non.mutated", "wt", mut_status_ts10)) %>% 
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(mut_status_ts10)) %>% 
                        deframe) %>% 
  purrr::set_names(names(gotcha_data))


SNV_cols <- list("MBL2"=c(`NA`="lightgrey", "mutated"="darkseagreen3", "wt"="black"),
                 "MBL4"=c(`NA`="lightgrey", "mutated"="purple4", "wt"="black"))

# filter celltypes according to comparisons and make heatmaps
B_HC_significant_heteroplasmy_changes <- all_significant_heteroplasmy_changes %>%
    dplyr::filter(comparison %in% c("B_vs_HC_MBL", "B_vs_CLL"),
                  patient_id %in% c("MBL2", "MBL4")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("B_vs_LC_MBL", "B_vs_HC_MBL", "B_vs_CLL"))) %>%
    split(.$patient_id) %>% 
    list_drop_empty

B_HC_CLL_insignificant_heteroplasmy_changes <- all_insignificant_heteroplasmy_changes %>% 
  dplyr::filter(comparison %in% c("B_vs_HC_MBL", "B_vs_CLL"),
                  patient_id %in% c("MBL2", "MBL4"))%>%
    dplyr::mutate(comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("B_vs_LC_MBL", "B_vs_HC_MBL", "B_vs_CLL"))) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(desc(max_blike_heteroplasmy)) %>% 
    split(.$patient_id) %>% 
    map(~slice_head(., n = 3)) %>% 
    list_drop_empty

B_HC_CLL_heteroplasmy_changes <- map2(.x= B_HC_significant_heteroplasmy_changes,
                               .y= B_HC_CLL_insignificant_heteroplasmy_changes,
                               ~bind_rows(.x, .y))

HC_CLL_enrichment <- map2(
  .x = B_HC_significant_heteroplasmy_changes %>%
    map(~ dplyr::filter(., comparison %in% c("B_vs_HC_MBL", "B_vs_CLL")) %>%
      tidyr::separate(comparison, into = c("numerator", "denominator"), sep = "_vs_", remove = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(enrichment = if_else(Change > 1, denominator, numerator)) %>%
      dplyr::select(variant_id, enrichment) %>%
      deframe()),
  .y = B_HC_CLL_insignificant_heteroplasmy_changes %>%
    map(~ dplyr::filter(., comparison %in% c("B_vs_HC_MBL", "B_vs_CLL")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(enrichment = "not significant") %>%
      dplyr::select(variant_id, enrichment) %>%
      deframe()), 
  .f = ~ c(.x, .y)
)

enrichment_cols <- list("MBL2"=c(my_MBL_CLL_colours_named, "not significant" ="lightgrey"),
                        "MBL4"=c(my_MBL_CLL_colours_named, "not significant"="lightgrey"))

celltypes <- SNV_heatmap_data %>% 
  map(~dplyr::select(., label_cellbarcode, My_heatmap_annotation) %>% 
        dplyr::mutate(My_heatmap_annotation=if_else(My_heatmap_annotation =="HC_MBL", "HC_MBL_B_Cells", My_heatmap_annotation)) %>% 
        deframe)

SNV_heteroplasmy_heatmaps <- list()
for (p in c("MBL2", "MBL4")){
  print(p)
  hm <- make_SNV_matching_heteroplasmy_heatmap(meta_data=metadata_all,
    heteroplasmy_matrix=heteroplasmy.cln.variants[[p]], 
    patient_name = p,
    changes_oi=B_HC_CLL_heteroplasmy_changes[[p]],
    celltype_annotation= celltypes[[p]],
    SNV_annotation = SNVs[[p]],
    SNV_colours= SNV_cols[[p]],
    enrichment_annotation=HC_CLL_enrichment[[p]],
    enrichment_colours=enrichment_cols[[p]])
  
  SNV_heteroplasmy_heatmaps[[p]] <- hm
}

cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = SNV_heteroplasmy_heatmaps, nrow=1, ncol=2)
```

```{r}
gotcha_quantification_plot <- gotcha_data %>%
```

## Fisher exact test
```{r}
 gotcha_data %>% 
  imap(~dplyr::mutate(., celltype=celltypes[[.y]][label_cellbarcode]) %>% 
         dplyr::group_by(celltype, mut_status_ts10, SNV, patient_id) %>% 
         dplyr::summarize(counts=n())) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = mut_status_ts10, values_from = counts) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(SNV) %>% 
  dplyr::select(celltype, SNV, mutated, non.mutated) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(celltype)) %>% 
  split(.$SNV) %>% 
  map(~ungroup(.x) %>% 
        dplyr::select(celltype, mutated, non.mutated) %>% 
        column_to_rownames("celltype") %>% 
        as.matrix()%>% 
        fisher.test)
```

```{r}
clonality_percentage_data <- clonotypes_cell_counts_all %>% 
  purrr::discard(names(clonotypes_cell_counts_all) == "MBL7dup") %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  group_by(label) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    percentage_major_clone = max(`Clonotype frequency [% cells]`),
    max_cluster = Cluster[which.max(`Clonotype frequency [% cells]`)]) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    max_cluster = dplyr::first(max_cluster),
    percentage_major_clone = dplyr::first(percentage_major_clone),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(metadata_all %>% dplyr::filter(data_type=="ATAC") %>% dplyr::select(label, plotting_id, disease, MBL_subtype)) %>% 
  tidyr::unite("MBL_CLL_subtype", c(MBL_subtype, disease), sep = "_", remove = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(MBL_CLL_subtype = factor(MBL_CLL_subtype, levels = c("LC_MBL", "HC_MBL", "CLL")),
                percentage_minor_clones=100-percentage_major_clone) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(MBL_subtype, disease)) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -c(plotting_id, label, MBL_CLL_subtype, max_cluster),names_to = "clonality", values_to = "percentage") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(clonality=case_when(clonality=="percentage_major_clone" ~ "monoclonal",
                                    clonality=="percentage_minor_clones" ~ "polyclonal",
                                    .default=NA)         )

monoclonal_percentage_plot <- clonality_percentage_data %>% 
  dplyr::filter(clonality=="monoclonal") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=MBL_CLL_subtype, y=percentage, fill = MBL_CLL_subtype))+

  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, colour = "black", aes(fill = MBL_CLL_subtype), pch = 21) +
  scale_x_discrete(name="", labels=c("LC_MBL"="LC-MBL", "HC_MBL"="HC-MBL","CLL"="CLL"))+

  scale_colour_manual(values = my_MBL_CLL_colours_named, labels=c("LC_MBL"="LC-MBL", "HC_MBL"="HC-MBL","CLL"="CLL")) +
```

### Chi2 scatterplots clonotype frequency
Perform chi2 test to find out if clonotype is associated with disease state
```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=12}
build_coningency_tables <- function(clono_cll_cnts, ptnt_label) {
  all_clonotype_ch2p_values <- list()

  for (clonotype in unique(clono_cll_cnts$Cluster)) {
    this_clonotype_MBL <- clono_cll_cnts %>%
      filter(Cluster == clonotype & label == "MBL") %>%
      pull(`cell counts`)
    
    this_clonotype_CLL <- clono_cll_cnts %>%
      filter(Cluster == clonotype & label == "CLL") %>%
      pull(`cell counts`)
    
    other_clonotypes_MBL <- clono_cll_cnts %>%
      filter(Cluster != clonotype & label == "MBL") %>%
      dplyr::summarise(n = sum(`cell counts`)) %>%
      pull()
    
    other_clonotypes_CLL <- clono_cll_cnts %>%
      filter(Cluster != clonotype & label == "CLL") %>%
      dplyr::summarise(n = sum(`cell counts`)) %>%
      pull()

    contingency_table <- data.frame("MBL" = c(this_clonotype_MBL, other_clonotypes_MBL), 
                                    "CLL" = c(this_clonotype_CLL, other_clonotypes_CLL), 
                                    row.names = c("this_clonotype", "other_clonotypes"))
    
    ch2p_value <- chisq.test(contingency_table, correct = FALSE) %>% .$`p.value`
    result <- tibble("Cluster" = clonotype, "p_value" = ch2p_value)
    all_clonotype_ch2p_values[[clonotype]] <- result
  }

  all_clonotype_ch2p_values <- all_clonotype_ch2p_values %>% bind_rows()
}
```


```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=12}
# Apply function to all samples and clonotypes
ch2_stat <- clonotypes_cell_counts_all_paired %>%
  map(~ dplyr::select(., -`Clonotype frequency [% cells]`) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(label = case_when(
      str_ends(label, "\\.1") ~ "MBL",
      str_ends(label, "\\.2") ~ "CLL", TRUE ~ label
    )) %>%
    build_coningency_tables())
```


```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=12}
# Apply Benjamini Hochberg Correction for multiple testing
clonotypes_cell_counts_all_paired_stats <- clonotypes_cell_counts_all_paired %>% 
  map2(
  ch2_stat,
  ~ dplyr::select(.x, -`cell counts`) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = `label`, values_from = `Clonotype frequency [% cells]`) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      `Clonotype frequency MBL [% cells]` = ends_with(".1"),
      `Clonotype frequency CLL [% cells]` = ends_with(".2")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      `Clonotype frequency MBL [% cells]` = replace_na(`Clonotype frequency MBL [% cells]`, 0),
      `Clonotype frequency CLL [% cells]` = replace_na(`Clonotype frequency CLL [% cells]`, 0),
      Cluster = as.character(Cluster)
    ) %>%
    left_join(.y, by = join_by(Cluster)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p_adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH", n = length(.$p_value)),
      significance = p_value <= 0.05 & p_adjust <= 0.05,
      clonotype_label = case_when(significance == "TRUE" ~ Cluster, .default = NA)
    )
)
```

Calculate median stablity or instability of clonotypes
```{r}
clonotypes_cell_counts_all_paired_stats[names(clonotypes_cell_counts_all_paired_stats) != "CLL6"] %>%
  imap(~ mutate(.x,
      `Change CLL/MBL` = (`Clonotype frequency CLL [% cells]` / `Clonotype frequency MBL [% cells]`),
      `threshold_1_2_fc` = `Change CLL/MBL` >= 1.2 & significance == TRUE | `Change CLL/MBL` <= 1 / 1.2 & significance == TRUE,
      `Stability` = if_else(threshold_1_2_fc == TRUE, "Instable", "Stable"),
      `patient_id` = .y
    )
  ) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = c("CLL1", "CLL2", "CLL3", "CLL4", "CLL5", "CLL7", "CLL8", "CLL9", "CLL10")),
    Stability = factor(Stability, levels = c("Stable", "Instable"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(patient_id, Stability) %>%
  dplyr::summarise("clonotype_counts" = n()) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Stability, values_from = clonotype_counts) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Instable = if_else(is.na(Instable), 0, Instable)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    All = sum(Stable, Instable),
    "Stable_p" = Stable / All * 100,
    "Instable_p" = Instable / All * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_stable = median(Stable_p),
    median_instable = median(Instable_p)
  )
```

### Clonotype localisation UMAP
```{r, fig.width=40, fig.height=20}
# CLL1-3
for (patient in c("CLL1", "CLL2", "CLL3")) {
  clusters <- clonotypes_cell_counts_all_paired_stats[[patient]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(significance == TRUE) %>%
    pull(Cluster)
  print(clusters)

  all_clonotype_umaps <- list()

  # Get umap for all clonotypes per patient
  for (cluster in clusters) {
    cluster_label_cellbarcode <- c(MBL.clonotypes_all[[patient]]@active.ident[MBL.clonotypes_all[[patient]]@active.ident == cluster], CLL.clonotypes_all[[patient]]@active.ident[CLL.clonotypes_all[[patient]]@active.ident == cluster])

    umap_subset1 <- CLLProj_Subset1@embeddings@listData[["UMAP"]]@listData[["df"]] %>% rownames_to_column(var = "label_cellbarcode")

    umap_subset1_cluster_oi <- full_join(umap_subset1, cluster_label_cellbarcode %>% enframe(name = "label_cellbarcode", value = "cluster")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(cluster = as.character(cluster)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(cluster = if_else(is.na(cluster), "Other clonotypes", cluster)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        cluster = factor(cluster),
        cluster = forcats::fct_rev(cluster)
      )

    umap_clonotype <- umap_subset1_cluster_oi %>%
      arrange(cluster) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = `IterativeLSI#UMAP_Dimension_1`, y = `IterativeLSI#UMAP_Dimension_2`, colour = cluster)) +
      geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8, stroke = NA) +
      coord_equal() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c("#D3D3D3", "#483D8B"), name = "Clonotype") +
      labs(x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2", title = paste(patient)) +
      theme_pub() +
      theme_pub() +
      theme(
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal"
      )

    all_clonotype_umaps[[cluster]] <- umap_clonotype
  }

  # arrange umap annotation with all clonotype umaps
  CLLProj_Subset1_annotation <- plotEmbedding(
    plotAs = "point",
    embedding = "UMAP",
    CLLProj_Subset1,
    colorBy = "cellColData",
    name = "My_Annotation",
    pal = annotation_colours_named
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    labs(x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
    theme_pub() +
    theme(
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal"
    )


  patient_figure <- ggarrange(
    plotlist = append(list(CLLProj_Subset1_annotation), all_clonotype_umaps),
    ncol = 4,
    nrow = 2,
    align = "h"
  ) %>% iwalk(ggsave(plot = ., 
                     filename = file.path(plotting_dir, paste0("Clonotype_chi2_umaps/Clonotype_chi2_umaps_", patient, ".pdf")), 
                     width = 60, 
                     height = 30, 
                     unit = "cm"))
  plot(patient_figure)
}
```

### Quantify clusters histogram
```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=24}
quantify_cluster_histogram <- function(cluster_counts, sample_name) {
  pm <- cluster_counts %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      disease = case_when(str_ends(label, pattern = "\\.1") ~ "MBL",
        str_ends(label, pattern = "\\.2") ~ "CLL",
        str_starts(label, pattern = paste0(c("MBL3", "MBL4"), collapse = "|")) ~ "CLL",
        str_starts(label, pattern = paste0("MBL", c(1:2, 6:9), collapse = "|")) ~ "MBL",
        .default = label
      ),
      Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = c(0, seq(1:1000)))
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Cluster, y = `Clonotype frequency [% cells]`, fill = disease, group = `label`)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge2") +
    theme_pub() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = my_MBL_CLL_colours_named, name = "Disease") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)) +
    labs(title = sample_name)

  return(pm)
}

clonotype_quantification_histograms <- clonotypes_cell_counts_all %>%
  imap(~ quantify_cluster_histogram(.x, .y))

ggarrange(
  plotlist = clonotype_quantification_histograms,
  ncol = 3,
  nrow = 9,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "right"
) %>%
  ggsave(plot = .,
    filename = file.path(plotting_dir, "Clonotype_quantification_histograms.png"),
    width = 30,
    height = 75,
    units = "cm"
  )

ggarrange(
  plotlist = clonotype_quantification_histograms,
  ncol = 3,
  nrow = 9,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "right"
)
```

```{r, fig.width=10}
# clonotype freq changes in both disease states disappears after MBL: 1,3, 6, 7, 8,9, 10
fraction_p_1 <- clonotypes_cell_counts_all[c(1, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10)] %>%
  map(~ group_by(., Cluster) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(disease = case_when(str_ends(label, pattern = ".1") ~ "MBL", .default = "CLL")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cluster_in_both_diseases = any(disease %in% "MBL") & any(disease %in% "CLL"),
      `Absolute % change` = if_else(cluster_in_both_diseases,
        abs(`Clonotype frequency [% cells]`[disease == "MBL"] - `Clonotype frequency [% cells]`),
        `Clonotype frequency [% cells]`
      )
    ))


# clonotype freq changes in both disease states disappears after CLL: 2, 4,
fraction_p_2 <- clonotypes_cell_counts_all[c(2, 4, 5)] %>%
  map(~ group_by(., Cluster) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(disease = case_when(str_ends(label, pattern = ".1") ~ "MBL", .default = "CLL")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cluster_in_both_diseases = any(disease %in% "MBL") & any(disease %in% "CLL"),
      `Absolute % change` = if_else(cluster_in_both_diseases,
        abs(`Clonotype frequency [% cells]`[disease == "CLL"] - `Clonotype frequency [% cells]`),
        `Clonotype frequency [% cells]`
      )
    ))

    legend.position = "right",
    legend.direction = "vertical"
```

```{r warnings=FALSE}
clonotypes_annotation <- clonotypes %>%
  map(~ .@active.ident %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("label_cellbarcode") %>%
    dplyr::rename(Cluster = ".")) %>%
  bind_rows()

mean_heteroplasmy_clonotype <- VAF_values_all_paired[-6] %>%
  map(~ unite(., "label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
    left_join(clonotypes_annotation, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
    dplyr::rename("clonotype" = Cluster) %>%
    left_join(my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(clonotype)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(My_annotation %in% c("MBL_B_Cells", "CLL_B_Cells")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(clonotype = as.character(clonotype)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(label, clonotype) %>%
    summarise_at(vars(VAF), list(`Heteroplasmy mean per sample` = mean)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(`Heteroplasmy mean per sample` = replace_na(`Heteroplasmy mean per sample`, 0)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = `Heteroplasmy mean per sample`) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      `Heteroplasmy mean MBL` = ends_with(".1"),
      `Heteroplasmy mean CLL` = ends_with(".2")
    ))

# Calculate p-values between MBL and CLL heteroplasmy
# clonotype 8 of CLL3 only in MBL no test possible
# clonotype 10 of CLL7 only in

p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype <- VAF_values_all_paired[-c(1, 3, 6, 8)] %>%
  map2(
    names(.),
    ~ tidyr::unite(., "label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::filter(variant_id != "310T>C") %>%
      dplyr::left_join(y = my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(y = clonotypes_annotation, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
      dplyr::rename("clonotype" = Cluster) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(clonotype)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(`My_annotation` %in% c("MBL_B_Cells", "CLL_B_Cells")) %>%
      mutate(clonotype = as.character(clonotype)) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(clonotype) %>%
      do(p_value = wilcox.test(filter(., `My_annotation` == "MBL_B_Cells") %>% pull(VAF),
        filter(., `My_annotation` == "CLL_B_Cells") %>% pull(VAF),
        paired = FALSE
      )$p.value) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        p_value = unlist(p_value),
        patient_id = .y
      ) %>%
      mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH", n = length(.$p_value))) %>%
      dplyr::relocate(patient_id, .before = "clonotype")
  )

p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype_cll3 <- VAF_values_all_paired$CLL3 %>%
  tidyr::unite("label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(variant_id != "310T>C") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(y = my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(y = clonotypes_annotation, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
  dplyr::rename("clonotype" = Cluster) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(clonotype) & clonotype != "8") %>%
  dplyr::filter(`My_annotation` %in% c("MBL_B_Cells", "CLL_B_Cells")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(clonotype = as.character(clonotype)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(clonotype) %>%
  do(p_value = wilcox.test(filter(., `My_annotation` == "MBL_B_Cells") %>% pull(VAF),
    filter(., `My_annotation` == "CLL_B_Cells") %>% pull(VAF),
    paired = FALSE
  )$p.value) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_value = unlist(p_value),
    patient_id = "CLL3"
  ) %>%
  mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH", n = length(.$p_value))) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(patient_id, .before = "clonotype")

p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype_cll3 <- p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype_cll3 %>%
  add_row(
    patient_id = "CLL3",
    clonotype = "8",
    p_value = NA,
    p_adjust = NA,
    .after = 7
  )
p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype_cll7 <- VAF_values_all_paired$CLL7 %>%
  tidyr::unite("label_cellbarcode", label:cell_barcode, sep = "#", remove = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(variant_id != "310T>C") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(y = my_annotation_df, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(y = clonotypes_annotation, by = join_by(label_cellbarcode)) %>%
  dplyr::rename("clonotype" = Cluster) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(clonotype) & clonotype != "10") %>%
  dplyr::filter(`My_annotation` %in% c("MBL_B_Cells", "CLL_B_Cells")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(clonotype = as.character(clonotype)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(clonotype) %>%
  do(p_value = wilcox.test(filter(., `My_annotation` == "MBL_B_Cells") %>% pull(VAF),
    filter(., `My_annotation` == "CLL_B_Cells") %>% pull(VAF),
    paired = FALSE
  )$p.value) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_value = unlist(p_value),
    patient_id = "CLL3"
  ) %>%
  mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH", n = length(.$p_value))) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(patient_id, .before = "clonotype")

p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype_cll7 <- p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype_cll7 %>%
  add_row(
    patient_id = "CLL7",
    clonotype = "10",
    p_value = NA,
    p_adjust = NA,
    .after = 7
  )


p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype$CLL3 <- p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype_cll3
p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype$CLL7 <- p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype_cll7

p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype <- list(
  p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype$CLL1,
  p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype$CLL2,
  p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype$CLL3,
  p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype$CLL4,
  p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype$CLL5,
  p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype$CLL10,
  p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype$CLL7,
  p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype$CLL8,
  p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype$CLL9
) %>%
  set_names(names(mean_heteroplasmy_clonotype))


statistics_heteroplasmy_clonotype <- mean_heteroplasmy_clonotype %>%
  map2(
    p_values_heteroplasmy_clonotype,
    ~ left_join(.x, .y, by = join_by(clonotype)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        significance = p_adjust <= 0.05 & p_value <= 0.05,
        clonotype_label = case_when(significance == "TRUE" ~ clonotype, .default = NA)
      )
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=13.5}
scatterplot_heteroplasmy_clonotype <- statistics_heteroplasmy_clonotype %>%

      panel.grid.major = NULL,

)
```

### Stability subclones heteroplasmy histogram
```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
stability_1_5_fc_clonotype_histogram <- statistics_heteroplasmy_clonotype %>%
  imap(~ filter(.x, !is.na(p_value)) %>%
      mutate(
        `Change CLL/MBL` = (`Heteroplasmy mean CLL` / `Heteroplasmy mean MBL`),
        `threshold_1_5_fc` = `Change CLL/MBL` >= 1.5 & significance == TRUE | `Change CLL/MBL` <= 1 / 1.5 & significance == TRUE,
        `Stability` = if_else(threshold_1_5_fc == TRUE, "Instable", "Stable")
      )
  ) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = c("CLL1", "CLL2", "CLL3", "CLL4", "CLL5", "CLL6", "CLL7", "CLL8", "CLL9", "CLL10")),
    Stability = factor(Stability, levels = c("Stable", "Instable"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(patient_id, Stability) %>%
  dplyr::summarise("clonotype_counts" = n()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = patient_id,
    y = clonotype_counts,
    fill = Stability
  )) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~Stability, strip.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Stable" = "#082567", "Instable" = "#956A77")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, NA))) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Clonotypes [#]") +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "plain")
  )

saveRDS(stability_1_5_fc_clonotype_histogram, file.path(RDS_dir, "stability_diff_clonotype_histogram.RDS"))

stability_1_5_fc_clonotype_histogram %>%
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plotting_dir, "Clonotype_Heteroplasmy_Stability.png"),
    width = 12,
    height = 8,
    units = "cm"
  )
```
